mission: Run one per-host systemd GitHub-state worker that reads each tracked PR once per cycle (fingerprint-batched GraphQL, ETag-revalidated REST) and publishes atomic PR snapshots that every Yeet and orchestrator reader consumes instead of polling GitHub itself.
